import pixeltable as px

# Get the existing videos table
videos = px.get_table('videos')

# Define frame extraction UDF using the built-in FrameIterator at 1 fps
@px.udf
def extract_video_frames(video):
    for frame in px.FrameIterator(video, fps=1):
        yield frame

# Create a view that expands each video row into one row per frame
frames_view = videos.select(
    frame=extract_video_frames(videos.video)
)
